setup.target: the ledger HTTP API in this repo, started locally from the checkout with `python3 -m ledger` on port 8071; no UI, no external services.
setup.findings: README.md:9 gives the start command and port; README.md:11 names `GET /health` as the ready signal; ledger/server.py:95 reads `LEDGER_PORT` and `LEDGER_DB`; REQUIREMENTS.md holds the agreed behavior with IDs LR-1 to LR-8; an agent can start the app with only this checkout.
setup.looked_in: README.md, REQUIREMENTS.md, ledger/server.py, ledger/store.py, tests/; no Makefile, compose file, or package scripts.
setup.doctor_proof: saved output in evidence/doctor/setup.txt: ready after Start (exit 0), not ready after Stop (exit 1), on the commit recorded there.

commands.start: python3 .claude/skills/verify-ledger/scripts/framework/vf.py start --checkout ledger={checkout:ledger} --until "curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8071/health" -- env PYTHONPATH={checkout:ledger} python3 {checkout:ledger}/ledger/server.py

doctor.use_when: before driving the app by hand or running a check, or when a check stopped with "not ready".
doctor.environment: an instance started with the Start command in `harness.json`; the launch record in `evidence/launch/`.
doctor.result: prints `ready` and the loaded code's commit as JSON, exit 0.
doctor.failure: exit 1 with one reason per line (no instance, process gone, code on disk changed since launch, health probe failing); exit 2 when it could not tell. Start the app with the Start command, or restart it after editing code.
doctor.limits: says the process is up on the recorded code; says nothing about the data in it.

probe.use_when: checking a balance or an account's transactions after driving the API, or re-checking a verdict by hand.
probe.inputs: the account ID; `transactions <id>` lists its transactions newest first.
probe.environment: the database at `data/ledger.db` under the project root (or `LEDGER_DB`); the app need not be running.
probe.permissions: read-only; opens the database in read-only mode and imports no app code.
probe.result: one JSON object: the account row, or `{"transactions": [...]}`; `--full` adds every column.
probe.failure: exit 1 with `{"not_found": ..., "hint": ...}` when the account has no row; exit 2 with `STOPPED: <reason>` when the database is missing or unreadable.
probe.limits: reports stored state only, never what the API would answer.
